intro: Waiheke is a short ferry ride from central Auckland. Ferries leave regularly, so plan to arrive with time to spare.

sections.title: The Ferry
body: Ferries to Waiheke leave from downtown Auckland and arrive at Matiatia Wharf. Check the timetable before you travel and book ahead on busy weekends.

sections.title: To the Venue
body: Man O War is at the eastern end of the island, a drive from the wharf. We'll share transport details here once they're confirmed.

sections.title: Where to Stay
body: Many guests will want to stay on the island for the night. There are plenty of places on Booking.com and Airbnb; book early, as Waiheke is popular in April.
